bio: Located in the CityQuartier Fünf Höfe shopping centre, the chic restaurant of renowned TV chef Ali Güngörmüs is named after his hometown in the Turkish province of Tunceli. Here, his team serves Middle Eastern cuisine that draws on classic French influences and is available as a four-course vegetarian Levante Menu and as a five- or six-course Chef Menu. A starter dubbed Meze, for example, is a great option comprising various small dishes. A number of noteworthy Turkish labels are included in the extensive wine list. The lovely sheltered terrace is delightful on summer days....
